title: Decision, evidence, and membership digests are distinct identities

sourceObjects.ref: explicit structured input: digest registry table v2

concepts.name: decisionDigest
concepts.digestMeaning: sha256 over the decision record body only (decided_at, decision, signer)
concepts.failureBehavior: a digest over any other payload is not a decisionDigest

concepts.name: evidenceDigest
concepts.digestMeaning: sha256 over the evidence payload only (supporting files, attestations)
concepts.failureBehavior: a digest over the decision record is not an evidenceDigest

concepts.name: membershipDigest
concepts.digestMeaning: sha256 over the membership registry entry only (member, role, joined_at)
concepts.failureBehavior: a digest over membership metadata is not a decisionDigest or evidenceDigest

distinctConcepts.mustNotConflate: decision digest covers the decision record only; evidence digest covers evidence payloads; they are never interchangeable
membership digest identifies a registry entry, never a decision
evidence digests and membership digests live in different registries

factsEstablished.fact: decisionDigest, evidenceDigest, membershipDigest cover disjoint payloads
